main_claim: A Yahoo preview predicts five UFC Paris main-card fights, picking Soriano to out-wrestle Donchenko.
note: The writer gives the Soriano-Donchenko bout its own analysis and pick ('I'm just not sure Donchenko has the tight, powerful boxing necessary'), which is a preview of a fight of his covering both men, so one_of_several; but he is one of ten fighters in a five-fight card preview, so only_mentioned is defensible. The booking is the premise of the preview, not news, so no_fact.

main_claim: Justin Gaethje says he does not want to rematch anyone he lost to and would rather fight Conor McGregor.
note: Topuria appears only as the man Gaethje 'obliterated at UFC Freedom 250' and as the reason Gaethje skips Holloway and Oliveira ('since Topuria beat them... I got him back'), background in Gaethje's own story about his next fight. Gaethje fought him, so opponent_side; the act is none_of_these because Gaethje states a stance on his own next fight and says nothing plain about Topuria.

main_claim: Islam Makhachev ranks the welterweight contenders, dismissing Yaroslav Amosov as not dangerous and tipping Ian Garry as the next champion.
note: Makhachev's 'I don't think [Amosov] is a dangerous opponent... I saw the fight where someone shut down his wrestling' is a new assessment of him, shared with Prates, Morales, Rakhmonov and Garry, so one_of_several; he is one of five names in a roundup item, so only_mentioned is defensible. Makhachev is not booked against him, so other_fighter_side.

main_claim: Ali Abdelaziz says he wants Usman Nurmagomedov's UFC debut to be against Ilia Topuria and that Usman would make him quit.
note: 'La pelea que quiero... es Ilia Topuria para su primera pelea... Usman hará que Ilia se rinda. Lo golpeará, lo pateará y lo noqueará' is a callout naming him as a wanted opponent, and the rest (the Makhachev negotiations, the Gaethje loss) is recap, so only_mentioned per the callout rule, though the article is built around Topuria so one_of_several is arguable. Abdelaziz speaks for Usman, who is not booked against him, hence other_fighter_side; the taunt reads as calls_him_out, though it is also phrased as a prediction. No fight exists, so no_fact.

main_claim: UFC.com's UFC Paris main-card results: Donchenko beat Soriano by unanimous decision (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) for his third straight UFC win.
note: His bout gets a full fight account ('hurt Soriano in the opening round... clean sweep of the scorecards'), one of five on the main-card results page, so one_of_several; the guide lists a results page under only_mentioned, so that is defensible. His call for Daniel Rodriguez is a wish, so next fight is no, and it is described, not quoted ('Donchenko Speaks From The Octagon' is a link), so he_speaks is no.

main_claim: Justin Gaethje says he will not fight again this year because of a knee bruise and hand injury and has not decided whether to retire.
note: Topuria appears in one writer's line ('the path forward includes a possible rematch against Ilia Topuria') with no who, when or where, so no next-fight fact; Gaethje, who fought him, speaks only about his own injuries and retirement, so the act is none_of_these.

main_claim: Topuria's manager Malki Kawa fires back at Ali Abdelaziz, saying Topuria would beat every fighter Abdelaziz represents, including Gaethje in a rematch.
note: Kawa 'responded with a social media post defending his client' against Abdelaziz's claim that Usman would make Topuria quit, a reply on his behalf. His 'promised a dominant return' and the writer's 'Topuria has not announced his next fight' could be read as status_update, but they are a manager's promise and a background line, so no_fact. Kawa's words are paraphrased, not quoted, and Topuria never speaks.

main_claim: A feature on Topuria's Alicante roots, where he says all he has in life, including his friends, is there and that he is a normal, non-aggressive person.
note: The body and headline are his life story and his quotes ('Todo lo que tengo en mi vida, como mis amigos, está aquí', 'soy una persona bastante normal'), so personal_life from himself; but the lead says his physical trainer 'señala que físicamente podría estar listo a finales de año', a return window from his team, which an editor could take as the main claim (status_update, his_team, gives_news_of_him, reported). 'Fase de recuperación' is the writer's line and only says when he will be ready, so health is no.

main_claim: Islam Makhachev says Topuria is still young and a good fighter and can be champion again if he refocuses after the Gaethje loss.
note: 'Todavía es joven, tiene tiempo... Ilia es un buen peleador' and 'Si se centra, puede ser campeón otra vez' assess his level and chances; the 'debe recuperar la concentración' line could be read as steers_him. Makhachev never fought him and no fight is booked, so other_fighter_side; the eye injuries and the stalled Makhachev talks are recap.

main_claim: After Ali Abdelaziz said Usman Nurmagomedov would make Topuria quit, Topuria's manager Malki Kawa replied that Topuria would annihilate Abdelaziz's whole roster and beat Gaethje in a rematch.
note: The article is a two-sided war of words about Topuria: Abdelaziz's 'Usman haría rendirse a Ilia' (Usman's manager, not booked against him: other_fighter_side, calls_him_out) and Kawa's reply 'Cállate la boca. Ilia Topuria aniquilaría al 100% de tu róster' (his_manager, answers_for_him); I took the reply as the article's news, and the headline's quote makes the other reading reasonable, while the shared stage with Usman makes one_of_several defensible. The Gaethje rematch and Pimblett are listed by the writer as open options, so no_fact.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to return and the UFC's dilemma is whether his next fight is the Gaethje rematch or Paddy Pimblett.
note: 'Dana White... ha dicho que el peleador hispanogeorgiano está listo para volver' with opponents named only as options ('¿Va a pelear contra Gaethje o contra Pimblett?') is status_update from the promotion; the readiness is the writer's paraphrase while Dana's quoted words are only about the choice of opponent, so no_fact or reported is defensible. Early-2027 timing is the writer's guess, and 'sanar las heridas' is recap, so health is no.

main_claim: Punahele Soriano says being underestimated helps him ahead of his UFC Paris fight with Daniil Donchenko, whom he calls a scary, wild young fighter.
note: Soriano 'meets Daniil Donchenko on September 5 at Accor Arena', so he is opponent_side and the article ties his interview to a booked fight between the two; '100 percent, man; scary dude, wild dude... he's young and has that young man's fire' assesses him. The booking is the premise of the interview, not news, so no_fact.

main_claim: Justin Gaethje says Topuria's predictable footwork, never moving laterally, was the flaw his game plan exploited at UFC Freedom 250.
note: 'He never changes the rhythm of his feet... Our game plan was to disrupt his footwork' is Gaethje, who fought him, assessing Topuria's game, the headline topic; the second half is Gaethje's own injuries and layoff, so one_of_several is defensible. The June injuries are recap and 'the potential rematch will not be happening this year' is the writer's inference, so no_fact.

main_claim: Daniil Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Fight Night in Paris, dropping him twice in the first round.
note: A fight report: 'упевнено переміг... одноголосим рішенням суддів – 30-27, 30-27, 29-28' with a round-by-round account. His post-fight callout of Daniel Rodriguez is a wish, so next fight is no, and it is described, not quoted (the embedded tweet is the UFC's), so he_speaks is no.

main_claim: Topuria, back in public with a letter to his son after three months of silence, tells how watching his parents work and a six-year separation from them forged his promise to build a better life for his family.
note: His own words about childhood, parents and home ('Yo veía trabajar a mi madre y a mi padre... quería cambiarla', 'Mi hogar eran los míos') make the fact personal_life; the lead's 'reaparecía... después de casi tres meses sin hablar' could be read as status_update for his return to public life, or the whole piece as a reflection with no_fact. The Gaethje loss is recalled only as the backdrop.
